Customer.description: Details about the customer placing the order.

loyaltyProviderCustomerId.description: The customer's unique identifier within the loyalty provider's system.

Item.description: Details for an individual item within the order. This schema is recursive, supporting nested items (e.g., modifiers).

plu.description: The Product Look-Up code for the item.

name.description: The display name of the item.

price.description: The base price of the item (before any item-specific discounts). It will be sent as an integer with 2 decimal digits, e.g. 1 euro would be sent as 100.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item in the order.

subItems.description: A list of child items or modifiers (recursive Item structure).

Discount.description: Details for a discount applied to the entire order or to specific items.

name.description: The name or title of the discount for display purposes.

programId.description: The ID of the loyalty program that generated this discount.

x-enum-descriptions.order_percent_off: Order Percentage Off (Order-Level): A percentage discount applied to the subtotal of the entire order.
x-enum-descriptions.order_flat_off: Order Flat Off (Order-Level): A fixed monetary amount discount applied to the subtotal of the entire order.
x-enum-descriptions.item_percent_off: Item Percentage Off (Item-Level): A percentage discount applied to a specific item or group of items in the basket.
x-enum-descriptions.item_flat_off: Item Flat Off (Item-Level): A fixed monetary amount discount applied to a specific item or group of items in the basket.
x-enum-descriptions.item_bogof: Item Buy One Get One Free (Item-Level, Promotional): A promotional discount where the price of one or more items is reduced, typically to zero, based on the purchase of other items.
x-enum-descriptions.item_free: Item Free (Item-Level, Promotional): A discount used to set the price of a specific item to zero (a free item).
x-enum-descriptions.wallet_cash: Wallet Cash (Source-Specific): A discount generated by redeeming the customer's cash or stored value balance from their loyalty wallet.
x-enum-descriptions.compensation_card: Compensation Card (Source-Specific): A discount generated from a compensation, gift, or store credit card.

amount.description: The monetary value of the discount (in the smallest currency unit). For percentage discounts, the value 3033 represents a percent discount of 30.33%.

apiKey.description: A unique identifier, typically a string of characters, used to authenticate and authorize a user, application, or project when interacting with an API.

accountId.description: The Deliverect's account id of the customer.

phoneNumber.description: phone number of the end customer in E164 format.

firstName.description: first name of the end customer

lastName.description: last name of the end customer

dateOfBirth.description: date of birth of the end customer in ISO format

loyaltyProfileId.description: The loyalty profile id being use

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the merchant account.

channelLinkId.description: The unique identifier linking the channel to the account/location.

locationId.description: The unique identifier for the specific location/store where the order was placed.

paymentAmount.description: The final amount paid by the customer.

customer.description: Details about the customer who placed the order.

created.description: Timestamp of when the order was created. May be `null` in some initial API calls (e.g., `get programs`).

channelOrderDisplayId.description: The order ID displayed to the customer on the channel.

orderId.description: The system's unique identifier for the order.

items.description: A list of all items included in the order.

subTotal.description: The total price of all items before taxes and discounts.

taxTotal.description: The total tax applied to the order.

discountTotal.description: The total value of all discounts applied to the order.

discounts.description: A list of all applied discounts.

decimalDigits.description: The number of decimal places used for currency precision. Default is 2.

serviceCharge.description: Any service fee applied to the order.

bagFee.description: Any fee applied for packaging or bags.

driverTip.description: The tip specifically allocated for the driver.

smallOrderFee.description: Any fee applied for not meeting a minimum order threshold.

schema.description: This schema defines the comprehensive structure of an order used for loyalty operations (such as program validation or redemption).

discounts.description: Discounts already applied to the order.
